'''Richard Becker''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 1999 Boca Raton tournament]] on 21 November 1999 with TIE Scout, according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d125">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-24-11-22-99-boca-raton-florida-back-in-saddled125/ 11-22-99-boca-raton-florida-back-in-saddle], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 24 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-24-11-22-99-boca-raton-florida-back-in-saddled125/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
